tax.text: Ellman criticized tax breaks for billionaires and large corporations as coming at the expense of the middle class.
tax.quote: give more tax breaks to billionaires and billion-dollar companies on the backs of the middle class

wages.text: Ellman supports passing the PRO Act to protect union organizing and end right-to-work laws.
wages.quote: passing the PRO Act to protect workers who are organizing a union, to end right to work laws

debt.text: Ellman said the Social Security retirement age should be lowered for people in physically demanding jobs.
debt.quote: We should be moving that Social Security age down for those people

housing.text: Ellman calls for expanding the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit to create and preserve affordable housing.
housing.quote: Expanding the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit to help create and preserve affordable housing.

immigration.text: Ellman uses welcoming language on immigration, saying there is room in the country for everyone who wants to call it home.
immigration.quote: She believes there is room in this country for everyone who wants to call it home.

abortion.text: Ellman says she has long supported reproductive freedom.
abortion.quote: Alissa has long supported LGBTQ+ rights, reproductive freedom, and equal rights for all Americans.

health.text: Ellman proposes expanding Medicare, starting by covering people who do physical labor down to age 45.
health.quote: Why don't we take Medicare for All and initially cover everybody who does physical labor, expand Medicare for those people down to age 45

tax.text: Tenney touts being the only New York Republican to vote for both of Trump's major tax-cut laws.
tax.quote: I am the only New York Republican who voted for both of President Trump's landmark tax bills: the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) in 2017 and H.R. 1, the Working Families Tax Cuts.

trade.text: Tenney voted to enforce U.S. trade laws against Chinese solar imports, opposing a tariff waiver she said floods the market with unfairly traded products.
trade.quote: By allowing Chinese solar product manufacturers to flood our economy with unfairly traded products, Biden's rule undermines our trade laws and the principle of fair competition.

debt.text: Tenney introduced legislation reaffirming her commitment to preserving and strengthening Social Security benefits.
debt.quote: By reintroducing this legislation today, it highlights my advocacy and continued focus on safeguarding, preserving, and strengthening Social Security benefits for our seniors, retirees, and future generations.

housing.text: Tenney introduced the bipartisan Rental Housing Investment Act to expand housing supply through tax incentives for new construction.
housing.quote: The federal tax code should encourage the construction of more housing, not stand in the way.

schools.text: Tenney co-introduced the High-Quality Charter Schools Act to expand charter schools through a tax credit, framing it as expanding school choice.
schools.quote: The High-Quality Charter Schools Act provides a tax credit for charitable donations that will develop and expand the number of charter schools to provide even more students access to affordable school choice options.

safety.text: Tenney released a Law Enforcement Plan pledging to support police and ensure they have resources and protections.
safety.quote: I will always Back the Blue and fight to ensure these heroes have the resources, protections, and respect they deserve.

immigration.text: Tenney's border security plan calls for deporting criminal illegal aliens and cracking down on illegal border crossings.
immigration.quote: Any illegal alien who flees our immigration authorities or injures them during their evasion should immediately be deported

guns.text: Tenney opposed the 2022 Democratic gun-control package, framing new firearm restrictions as infringements on Second Amendment and due-process rights.
guns.quote: Instead of knee-jerk reactions that undermine due process and infringe on our Second Amendment, there are commonsense steps Congress can take now to address the problem.

abortion.text: Tenney describes herself as pro-life, framing the right to life as fundamental in a statement supporting pro-life legislation.
abortion.quote: The right to life is among the most basic and fundamental rights of our self-governing Constitutional Republic,

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Tenney voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which bars transgender women from women's sports based on sex at birth.
gender.quote: By passing this bill, we are protecting opportunities for female athletes to train, compete, and thrive.

health.text: Tenney opposes a government-run health system, favoring a market-based approach over expanding public coverage.
health.quote: New Yorkers deserve a health care system that is sustainable and transparent, not one distorted by politicians' radical attempts to force New Yorkers into a one-size-fits-all, government-controlled health care system.

energy.text: Tenney's energy plan prioritizes lowering costs and boosting domestic energy production over climate mandates.
energy.quote: My Energy and Environment Plan takes a practical approach that lowers costs, unleashes American energy production, strengthens our grid, and protects the beautiful natural resources that make Upstate and Western New York such a special place to live.

voting.text: As chair of the House Election Integrity Caucus, Tenney's plan pushes voter ID, citizenship verification, and cleaner voter rolls.
voting.quote: I remain committed to protecting the sacred right of American citizens to vote and advancing commonsense reforms that make it easy to vote and hard to cheat.
